verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no subscription API endpoints for create, update, pause, or cancel. It offers only recurring invoices (docs-16) and a general claim that the API covers all web-client operations (docs-37). Recurring invoices are an adjacent feature, not a documented subscription lifecycle. Combining them with a generic API-parity claim does not show pause or cancel operations exist.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, pause, and cancel subscriptions through a documented API — the full lifecycle without touching a dashboard
